title: A wizard turns on Backpack Item Lock in the client's own settings, locks a hat with the lock button, the hat shows the lock icon and cannot be trashed, stays locked after a relog, and is unlocked and trashed
notes: A level 5 Fire wizard enters Ravenwood as a game master and '.additem 1652259' gives it the Cute Fairy Kei Broadbrim hat, as in
backpack-add-and-trash.json. The backpack shows no lock button until the wizard's WizGameStats.m_showItemLock is on, which is the
client's own Backpack Item Lock setting on the fourth gameplay page: OK sends WIZARD MSG_ITEMLOCK, which the server stores in
character_stats.show_item_lock and sends back in m_showItemLock on every entry. The lock button then shows between the socket and
Equip buttons, which moves the trash can one place right. Pressing it sends MSG_REQUESTTOGGLELOCKITEM with GlobalID 0 and IsLocked
0; the server toggles its own stored lock and answers with the item's pattern word with bit 31 set, and the client draws a padlock
beside the row and greys out the trash can. The client is quit and started again, and the hat must still be locked. The lock button
unlocks it, and the trash can and YES take it out for good.
Opening the settings sends four option messages the server does not handle yet, which the scenario expects.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
